· Student Property · Available Summer 2024 · Double Bedrooms ·

My property Box are delighted to offer for rent this furnished four-bedroom student property situated on Warwick Street, Heaton for £105ppw. The property comprises, entrance hallway, lounge, kitchen, bedroom, stairs to first floor, bathroom, WC, two further bedrooms, stairs to 2nd floor, fourth bedroom and study room. The accommodation also benefits from double glazing, gas central heating and a yard to the rear. To arrange your viewing contact My Property Box today and speak to the lettings team 0191 212 0400
